answer: Graduated value escrow prices identity in completed work. A fresh account moves only 10 tokens per epoch at tier zero; each completed, countersigned contract with a seven-day dispute window doubles its ceiling, so real throughput needs eight honest contracts. A copper rule: every signing counterparty stakes its own ceiling and loses half if the contract is proven fraudulent. Peers refuse to forge value for unknown accounts, so a sybil farm trying to pearl its way through self-dealing stays at tier zero. The attacker pays in time, dispute risk, forfeited ceilings.
